hook: Japan just cut crypto taxes from 55% to 20%

stories.text: Japan passes bill to cut crypto tax to 20%
stories.summary: Japan's parliament approved a law recognizing crypto as a financial product and slashing the tax rate on gains from 55% to around 20%.

stories.text: South Korea moves to allow spot bitcoin ETFs
stories.summary: South Korea plans to amend its capital markets law in the second half of this year to permit spot bitcoin exchange-traded funds.
stories.source: The Korea Economic Daily Global Edition

stories.text: Hyperliquid lawyers meet SEC Crypto Task Force
stories.summary: The SEC Crypto Task Force held a formal meeting with Hyperliquid Policy Center representatives on July 14, 2026.

stories.text: UK and US forge stablecoin bridge for payments
stories.summary: The UK and US announced a joint stablecoin framework requiring 1:1 backing and segregated reserves for cross-border payments.

stories.text: Morgan Stanley files amended Ethereum Solana ETF
stories.summary: Morgan Stanley submitted amended registration documents for ETFs tied to Ethereum and Solana, with analysts saying a launch is near.
